name: Blade Ruiner (VST3)
description: Three layers at once: a drone city of nine detuned saws and filtered rain, an eight-voice polysynth with a ladder filter, and a sixteen-step sequencer built from a six-bit seed. At least one layer is always playing. A mood organ sits over all of it: dial a number from 0 to 999 and get an instrument and a line of text that belong to each other. All thousand are distinct, and a handful are Philip K. Dick's own codes.
note: Windows VST3 · build 261024.2 · free download · 18-page manual included.
